description: Two effects loops wired in series, with a switch that swaps which of them comes first

params.text: Off runs effect A first: in goes to send1, ret1 goes to send2, ret2 goes to out. On runs effect B first: in goes to send2, ret2 goes to send1, ret1 goes to out

inputs.text: The signal fed into the chain, and the number of channels here sets the number of channels at every output
The return from effect A, passed to send2 with the switch off and to out with the switch on
The return from effect B, passed to out with the switch off and to send1 with the switch on

outputs.text: Feeds effect A, carrying in with the switch off and ret2 with the switch on
Feeds effect B, carrying ret1 with the switch off and in with the switch on
The end of the chain, carrying ret2 with the switch off and ret1 with the switch on

notes: every output stays silent while in is unpatched, because the routing runs once per channel of in and an unpatched input has no channels
